sentences.text: Es sábado por la mañana.
sentences.english: It is Saturday morning.

sentences.text: Carlos está en su taller, con el martillo en la mano y una mesa grande.
sentences.english: Carlos is in his workshop, with the hammer in his hand and a big table.

sentences.text: Sobre una mesa pequeña hay un pato, un conejo, un oso y un león que él hace con sus manos y vende en el mercado.
sentences.english: On a small table there is a duck, a rabbit, a bear and a lion that he makes with his hands and sells at the market.

sentences.text: Sam llega con una bolsa de pan, porque sabe que Carlos no come nada antes de trabajar.
sentences.english: Sam arrives with a bag of bread, because he knows Carlos eats nothing before working.

sentences.text: Buenos días, Carlos.
sentences.english: Good morning, Carlos.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Te traje pan.
sentences.english: I brought you bread.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Cómo va el trabajo?
sentences.english: How is the work going?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Gracias, Sam.
sentences.english: Thank you, Sam.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: El trabajo va despacio.
sentences.english: The work is going slowly.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: La compañía todavía no me ha pagado la obra de la escuela, y ya pasó un mes.
sentences.english: The company has still not paid me for the school job, and a month has already passed.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Eso es triste.
sentences.english: That is sad.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Es una pérdida para vos, y es una obra muy hermosa.
sentences.english: It is a loss for you, and it is a very beautiful job.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Gracias.
sentences.english: Thanks.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Pero tengo que hablarte de algo, y quiero hacerlo con paz.
sentences.english: But I have to talk to you about something, and I want to do it politely.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Hace un mes te presté tres mil lempiras.
sentences.english: A month ago I lent you three thousand lempiras.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: ¿Lo recordás?
sentences.english: Do you remember?
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Claro que lo recuerdo.
sentences.english: Of course I remember.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Me los prestaste para el cuarto y para el boleto.
sentences.english: You lent them to me for the room and the ticket.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Me dijiste que ibas a devolvérmelos el día quince.
sentences.english: You told me you were going to return them to me on the fifteenth.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Hoy es veintiocho.
sentences.english: Today is the twenty-eighth.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Es verdad que te lo dije.
sentences.english: It is true that I told you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Pero vos también me dijiste algo: «Pagame cuando puedas».
sentences.english: But you also told me something: "Pay me when you can."
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Por eso pensé que no había problema.
sentences.english: That's why I thought there was no problem.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Eso es cierto, y no lo niego.
sentences.english: That is true, and I don't deny it.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Te lo dije.
sentences.english: I said it to you.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Pero lo dije cuando creía que la compañía iba a pagarme pronto.
sentences.english: But I said it when I thought the company was going to pay me soon.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Ahora las cosas han cambiado.
sentences.english: Now things have changed.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: La semana anterior a la vez que me pediste el dinero, yo ya tenía problemas con ellos.
sentences.english: The week before you asked me for the money, I already had problems with them.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Te presté el dinero porque imaginé que me lo ibas a devolver pronto.
sentences.english: I lent you the money because I imagined you would give it back to me soon.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Es verdadero que no te lo dije todo, pero es falso que quise engañarte.
sentences.english: It is true that I did not tell you everything, but it is false that I wanted to deceive you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Jamás lo quise.
sentences.english: I never wanted to.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Aunque no tengo todo el dinero, quiero resolver esto hoy.
sentences.english: Although I don't have all the money, I want to settle this today.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Cuánto necesitás?
sentences.english: How much do you need?
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Necesito todo, Sam.
sentences.english: I need all of it, Sam.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Con ese dinero compré herramientas y clavos para la obra de la escuela.
sentences.english: With that money I bought tools and nails for the school job.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Si la compañía no me paga, tengo una pérdida grande.
sentences.english: If the company doesn't pay me, I have a big loss.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: No puedo comprar nada más, y mis trabajadores esperan su sueldo.
sentences.english: I can't buy anything else, and my workers are waiting for their pay.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: No sabía que tenías trabajadores.
sentences.english: I didn't know you had workers.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Me sorprende.
sentences.english: It surprises me.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Tengo dos: un joven del pueblo y mi hermano.
sentences.english: I have two: a young man from the village and my brother.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Los dos son muy trabajadores.
sentences.english: Both are very hard-working.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: El día siguiente a la fiesta de la escuela ya me preguntaron por su sueldo, y yo no tenía qué decirles.
sentences.english: The day after the school party they already asked me about their pay, and I had nothing to tell them.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: La compañía me dijo tres veces que me iba a pagar «pronto», pero nunca me dijo cuándo.
sentences.english: The company told me three times that it was going to pay me "soon", but it never told me when.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Ya no creo en esa palabra.
sentences.english: I no longer believe that word.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Si no les pago, no me lo van a perdonar, y tendrían razón.
sentences.english: If I don't pay them, they won't forgive me, and they would be right.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Voy a ser honesto con vos.
sentences.english: I am going to be honest with you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Gasté parte del dinero en el cuarto y en el boleto, pero también presté una parte a Kevin, que la necesitaba para su pasaporte.
sentences.english: I spent part of the money on the room and the ticket, but I also lent a part to Kevin, who needed it for his passport.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Él me dijo que me la devolvía esta semana.
sentences.english: He told me he would return it to me this week.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: No te lo dije, y debí hacerlo.
sentences.english: I didn't tell you, and I should have.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Se la prestaste a Kevin sin decírmelo?
sentences.english: You lent it to Kevin without telling me?
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Eso me sorprende.
sentences.english: That surprises me.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Reconozco que me equivoqué.
sentences.english: I admit I made a mistake.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Se lo presté con buen corazón, pero no debí hacerlo sin preguntarte.
sentences.english: I lent it to him with good intentions, but I shouldn't have done it without asking you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Aunque lo hiciste con buen corazón, ese dinero no era tu dinero.
sentences.english: Although you did it with good intentions, that money wasn't yours.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Era el dinero de mi trabajo.
sentences.english: It was the money from my work.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: En ese momento llega el señor Marvin, que viene a pedirle una mesa a Carlos. Escucha lo que dicen desde fuera del taller y entra despacio.
sentences.english: At that moment Mr. Marvin arrives; he comes to ask Carlos for a table. He hears what they say from outside the workshop and comes in slowly.

sentences.text: Buenos días.
sentences.english: Good morning.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Perdonen que entre así.
sentences.english: Forgive me for coming in like this.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Se oían sus palabras desde la calle.
sentences.english: The conversation could be heard from the street.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: ¿Hay algún problema?
sentences.english: Is there a problem?
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Un problema de dinero, señor Marvin. Un problema entre amigos.
sentences.english: A money problem, Mr. Marvin. A loan between friends.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Los problemas de dinero se resuelven con cuidado y con paz.
sentences.english: Money problems are solved with honesty and peace.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Cuéntenme cada uno lo que pasó, uno por uno.
sentences.english: Tell me each of you your version, and don't interrupt each other.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Yo le presté tres mil lempiras a Sam hace un mes.
sentences.english: I lent Sam three thousand lempiras a month ago.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Me dijo que me los devolvía el quince.
sentences.english: He told me he would give them back on the fifteenth.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: No me los devolvió, y necesito el dinero para pagar a mis trabajadores.
sentences.english: He didn't give them back, and I need the money to pay my workers.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Es cierto que se lo prometí.
sentences.english: It is true that I promised it to him.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Pero Carlos me había dicho que le pagara cuando pudiera.
sentences.english: But Carlos had told me to pay him when I could.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Además, le presté una parte a Kevin, y todavía no me la ha devuelto.
sentences.english: Besides, I lent a part to Kevin, and he still hasn't returned it to me.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Entonces Carlos afirma una cosa, y Sam afirma otra.
sentences.english: So Carlos states one thing, and Sam states another.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Los dos suponen que el otro se olvidó.
sentences.english: Both suppose that the other forgot.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Yo distingo dos hechos: Carlos prestó el dinero, y Sam no lo devolvió el día quince.
sentences.english: I distinguish two facts: Carlos lent the money, and Sam did not return it on the fifteenth.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Lo otro son opiniones, y yo no voy a juzgar a ninguno.
sentences.english: The rest are opinions, and I am not going to judge either of you.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Aparte de eso, los dos quieren seguir siendo amigos, y eso también es un hecho.
sentences.english: Apart from that, you both want to remain friends, and that is also a fact.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Propongo un trato bueno para los dos.
sentences.english: I propose a deal that is good for both.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Primero, Sam, ¿cuánto dinero tenés hoy?
sentences.english: First, Sam, how much money do you have today?
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Tengo mil quinientos lempiras.
sentences.english: I have one thousand five hundred lempiras.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Los guardé para el próximo mes.
sentences.english: I saved them for next month.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Carlos, ¿aceptás mil quinientos hoy y lo otro en dos semanas?
sentences.english: Carlos, do you accept one thousand five hundred today and the rest in two weeks?
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Podría aceptarlo, pero ¿cómo sé que Sam va a cumplir?
sentences.english: I could accept it, but how do I know that Sam is going to keep his word?
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Ya me dijo una vez que pagaba el quince, y no pagó.
sentences.english: He already told me once that he would pay on the fifteenth, and he didn't.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Tenés razón en dudar.
sentences.english: You are right to doubt.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Te lo prometo otra vez, aunque sé que mi promesa ya no vale tanto.
sentences.english: I promise it to you again, although I know my promise is no longer worth as much.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Pero hay algo más: puedo trabajar para vos.
sentences.english: But there is something more: I can work for you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: No sé hacer una mesa, pero sé escribir cartas en buen español.
sentences.english: I don't know how to make a table, but I know how to write letters in good Spanish.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Cartas?
sentences.english: Letters?
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: ¿Para qué?
sentences.english: What for?
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Para la compañía. No puede negar un hecho: vos hiciste la obra de la escuela. Te escribo una carta cortés y clara, se la leo primero al señor Marvin, y después se la mando a la compañía.
sentences.english: For the company. It cannot deny a fact: you did the school job. I'll write you a courteous and clear letter, read it to Mr. Marvin first, and then send it to the company.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Es una buena idea.
sentences.english: It is a good idea.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Yo se la leo a la gente de la comunidad también, si Carlos quiere.
sentences.english: I will read it to the people of the community too, if Carlos wants.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Cuando la compañía vea que todos conocen el hecho, va a pagar más pronto.
sentences.english: When the company sees that everyone knows the fact, it will pay sooner.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Y la carta debe tener una fecha clara: el próximo lunes.
sentences.english: And the letter must have a clear date: next Monday.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Así «pronto» tendrá un día.
sentences.english: That way "soon" will have a day.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Aunque dudo un poco, acepto el trato.
sentences.english: Although I doubt a little, I accept the deal.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Pero quiero que lo firmemos los dos, para que nadie olvide lo que dijo.
sentences.english: But I want us both to sign it, so that nobody forgets what he said.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Claro.
sentences.english: Of course.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Lo escribo ahora y te lo traigo.
sentences.english: I'll write it now and bring it to you.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: En ese momento llega Kevin con una sonrisa y dinero en la mano.
sentences.english: At that moment Kevin arrives with a smile and money in his hand.

sentences.text: Sam, te traje lo que me prestaste.
sentences.english: Sam, I brought you what you lent me.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Mi jefe me dijo ayer que me pagaba hoy, y me pagó.
sentences.english: My boss told me yesterday that he would pay me today, and he paid me.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Aquí tenés quinientos lempiras.
sentences.english: Here you have five hundred lempiras.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Gracias, Kevin.
sentences.english: Thanks, Kevin.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Ahora mismo se los doy a Carlos.
sentences.english: I'm going to give them to Carlos right now.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Se los debía.
sentences.english: I owed them to him.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: ¿Se los das a Carlos?
sentences.english: You're giving them to Carlos?
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Entonces llegué en el mejor momento.
sentences.english: Then I arrived at the best moment.
sentences.speaker: E

sentences.text: Así es.
sentences.english: That's right.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Carlos, aquí tenés dos mil lempiras: los mil quinientos de hoy y los quinientos de Kevin.
sentences.english: Carlos, here you have two thousand lempiras: the one thousand five hundred from today and Kevin's five hundred.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Mil más en dos semanas, y la carta hoy.
sentences.english: A thousand more in two weeks, and the letter today.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Me los das, y yo los acepto.
sentences.english: You give them to me, and I accept them.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Así el trato queda más claro.
sentences.english: That way the deal is clearer.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Gracias, Sam.
sentences.english: Thank you, Sam.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Y gracias, Kevin.
sentences.english: And thank you, Kevin.
sentences.speaker: C

sections.title: Lo que dijo el señor Marvin

sentences.text: Antes de irme, quiero decirles una cosa.
sentences.english: Before I go, I want to tell you something.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Hay una forma antigua de resolver los problemas: hablar cara a cara.
sentences.english: There is an old way of solving problems: talking face to face.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Es natural, es humana, y sigue siendo la mejor, aunque la vida actual es moderna y difícil.
sentences.english: It is natural, it is human, and it is still the best, although life today is modern and complicated.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Hoy los dos fueron sinceros.
sentences.english: Today you were both sincere.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Sam describió lo que hizo, y Carlos expresó lo que sentía, sin pelear.
sentences.english: Sam described what he did, and Carlos expressed what he felt, without hatred.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: El peor camino siempre es no hablar.
sentences.english: The worst road is always silence.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Entre un amigo mayor y uno menor, o entre dos personas iguales, la verdad cuesta, pero ayuda.
sentences.english: Between an older friend and a younger one, or between two equals, the truth costs, but it heals.
sentences.speaker: V

sentences.text: Tiene razón, señor Marvin. Sam, no quiero que pienses que soy un hombre duro. Hablé así porque necesitaba el dinero, no para enojarme.
sentences.english: You are right, Mr. Marvin. Sam, I don't want you to think I'm a hard man. I spoke that way because I needed the money, not to get angry.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Lo sé, Carlos.
sentences.english: I know, Carlos.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Y yo no quiero que pienses que no soy honesto.
sentences.english: And I don't want you to think I'm not honest.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Me equivoqué, pero te lo dije todo.
sentences.english: I made a mistake, but I told you everything.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Entonces, para terminar bien el trato, te regalo este oso.
sentences.english: Then, to close the deal well, I'm giving you this bear.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: No es dinero, es un regalo.
sentences.english: It is not a payment, it is a gift.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Cada vez que lo mires, vas a recordar este día.
sentences.english: Every time you look at it you will remember this day.
sentences.speaker: C

sentences.text: Me lo guardo con cariño.
sentences.english: I'll keep it with affection.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Y cuando lo mire, voy a recordar que un amigo me dio tiempo cuando lo necesitaba.
sentences.english: And when I look at it, I'll remember that a friend gave me time when I needed it.
sentences.speaker: S

sentences.text: Los cuatro se dan la mano.
sentences.english: The four shake hands.

sentences.text: Carlos corta el pan que trajo Sam, todavía caliente, y todos lo comen en el taller, entre el pato, el conejo, el león y el oso.
sentences.english: Carlos cuts the bread that Sam brought, still warm, and everyone eats it in the workshop, among the duck, the rabbit, the lion and the bear.
